tools.name: nba_refs_tonight
tools.description: Tonight's NBA games with each referee crew and the whistle read in a word (busy, average or quiet), plus Monty's take on the night. Preview only: the full reports are on WhistleBets.

tools.name: nba_game_refs
tools.description: The referee crew for one NBA game (yesterday, today or tomorrow), the whistle read in a word, the foul-trouble watch and Monty's take; for last night's games, the score and whether the whistle ran busier or quieter than expected. Find it by team: 'Celtics', 'Boston' or 'BOS'.

tools.name: nba_referee
tools.description: A short read on one NBA referee: how busy their whistle tends to run (in a word), their late-game accuracy when it stands out, and their next assignment. Preview only: the full profile is on WhistleBets.
